reason: role_gated. The only function in 40acres that pays its caller is the portfolio account's RewardsProcessingFacet.processRewards (pays msg.sender a gasReclamation capped at 5% of the claimed rewards), and it is gated by onlyAuthorizedCaller -> PortfolioManager.authorizedCallers, an onlyOwner whitelist. In all of history exactly one caller was ever authorized (0x250600a035d14e0b079d9efa625393e7bfe83265, block 44261665), so a stranger cannot take it. Everything else is self-service: PortfolioManager.multicall runs against portfolioOf(msg.sender), the legacy Loan.claim requires msg.sender == the EntryPoint relayer, and the vault is plain ERC4626, so no stranger is ever paid. No liquidation path exists (self-repaying, non-liquidating loans).
